content:
The subject of unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) got a boost recently when former senior intelligence official Jay Stratton released his new memoir, Out of the Shadows, published by HarperCollins. He also appeared on Fox News’ Special Report with Bret Baier to discuss the news that has been leaking since President Trump authorized the UAP file drops.

Dishing Secrets

Jay Stratton isn’t a fringe commentator, judging by his background, which includes being a former senior US intelligence officer who previously led Pentagon investigations.

According to 100 Percent FedUp, Stratton’s book hit shelves on October 13, following his TV appearance on October 12.

While mainstream media seems to have little interest in covering the claims, the general public either grows skeptical about UAPs, or they think some folks are batshit crazy. Still, amid the skepticism, there is an audience of people who believe something is real about alien life on Earth.

UNILAD cited Jay Stratton as saying in his book, “We’re not the only intelligent life in the universe… We don’t know the intentions of the non-human intelligent life that’s here. We have ongoing UAP activity… over sensitive military and nuclear sites [and] the world has the right to know about this.”

Hectic Claims

More often these days, whistleblowers step up and say things that were previously whispered about in small forums. But on social media, many people have started believing that there might be more than just rumors about the U.S. government and defense contractors possessing recovered spacecraft and biological remains.

100 Percent Fed Up explained, “he just went on Bret Baier’s show and …To his credit, he didn’t hedge. He didn’t pull any punches. He just said it. Point blank, a few different times.”

Stratton said in the Fox News interview that he shared on X:

I have seen with my own eyes, non-human craft and non-human beings.

He also talked about footage showing a black triangular craft that maneuvered in ways that defied known physics. He claimed, “That was the moment that changed my world.”

Viewers React

During the Lainey and Ben podcast, where Jay Stratton’s interview with Fox was discussed, viewers seemed divided about the UAP revelations.

One of them wrote, “For Jay Stratton to go on Fox news and say everything he’s saying he must have been told to say it.”

Here are a few more reactions from the discussion:

  • “All these things that are coming out. Alien war. Crash retrieval programs. Bodies and government deals/control. I heard all these things 10-15 years ago and they were considered fringe.”
  • “I have Jay stratton book now at chapter 10 , he is aligned so far with david grusch , i believe they all are dealing with same source ! They never saw them personally but they trust this source so much.”
  • “Yes, I absolutely believe a story about aliens from a government operative that was televised on the world’s largest distributor of propaganda.”
